heading: Substitution Policy
body:
In some instances, the photo may represent an overall theme or look and include a one-of-a-kind vase which cannot be exactly replicated.

Although the bouquet may not exactly match the photo, its temperament will.

Occasionally, substitutions of flowers and/or vases happen due to weather, seasons and market availability, all which may affect arrangements. If this is the case with the arrangement you’ve selected, I will ensure that the style, theme and color scheme of your arrangement is preserved and will only substitute items of equal value or higher value.

If any design elements, such as flowers or colors are of major importance to your order, please include them in the instructions at checkout or contact through email to ensure availability.
